newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Ciampi welcomes Feb industrial data.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ciampi welcomes Feb industrial data.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said industrial production data for February showed a slight year-on-year rise of 0.8 percent when the number of working days was taken into account.

The unadjusted figure released by ISTAT on Tuesday showed a fall of 3.8 percent, based on 20 working days, against 21 days in February 1996. The January year-on-year figure was a fall of 6.4 percent, based on 21 working days.

"The February production figure should be seen positively because it is minus 3.8 percent as a statistic but there is one fewer working day and if you take that into account, this minus 3.8 percent becomes plus 0.8 percent," Ciampi told reporters.
He said it was too early to say whether the data pointed to an economic recovery.
"I'm not saying that there is a recovery. One swallow doesn't make a spring and we still have to wait for the March and April data," Ciampi said.
